title: Group the 34 ETH LossDiff Progress strategies in a dedicated Dashboard category
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Сделай для них отдельную LossDiff Progress категорию

scope.goal: Show exactly the existing 34 ETH LossDiff Positive Progress strategies in a dedicated Dashboard category named `ETH 5m LossDiff Progress`.
inScope: Dashboard display-category classification for the 16 existing Up4 children b7c50005-0000-4000-8236-{cap:12 digits}, caps 1..16, whose exact display names are `ETH 5m Up 4 bps Reference Average Premarket LossDiff Positive Progress Cap N`.

Dashboard display-category classification for the 18 existing Up8 children b7c50005-0000-4000-8237-{cap:12 digits}, caps 1..18, whose exact display names are `ETH 5m Up 8 bps Reference Average Premarket LossDiff Positive Progress Cap N`.
The category label is exactly `ETH 5m LossDiff Progress` and is available through the existing Dashboard category selector/filter path.
outOfScope: Changes to strategy identities, names, catalog rows, assignments, configuration, trading logic, LossDiff calculation, Progress sizing, caps, history, metrics, Paper/Live state, orders, database data, service state, or Production deployment.
Reclassification of any strategy outside the exact two existing 34-member families, including similarly named clones, aliases, future strategies, and non-Progress LossDiff strategies.
Any new Dashboard control, category hierarchy, sorting rule, currency classification, or visual redesign.
scope.periodOrFilter: Not applicable; category classification applies to the exact existing 34 strategies whenever they are displayed.
scope.firstVerification: Inspect the current Dashboard category classifier and its selector/filter consumers, then prove with focused tests that all 34 exact display names map to the new label while neighboring names retain their prior categories.

requirements.text: Classify exactly the existing 34 ETH LossDiff Positive Progress strategies into one Dashboard category whose visible label is `ETH 5m LossDiff Progress`.
acceptanceCriteria: Each exact Up4 display name with Cap 1 through Cap 16 returns `ETH 5m LossDiff Progress` from StrategyDisplayCategories.GetCategory.
Each exact Up8 display name with Cap 1 through Cap 18 returns `ETH 5m LossDiff Progress` from StrategyDisplayCategories.GetCategory.
The existing Dashboard category option builder exposes one `ETH 5m LossDiff Progress` option and the existing category filter includes these strategies when that option is selected.
Close but out-of-scope names, including out-of-range caps and non-Progress LossDiff names, are not classified into this category.

verification.expected: All focused category tests pass, including exact coverage of all 34 members and rejection of neighboring names.
